name: Lift a light object with stable posture
short_description: Lift a light object with stable posture once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can lift a light object with stable posture in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Lift a light object with stable posture means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Lift a light object with stable posture in a fresh real-life scenario.
